tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rta glud gtang ba bsdus pa bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo ār+ya re man+ta ye/

rta glud zan nam rtswa la rta gzugs bya// glud dang changs bu ting lo spu glud bran// rang nyid lhar gsal 'di skad brjod par bya// oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod du ti yig las// rta glud rta mchog rin chen dpag med dang*// g.yung drel rlung gi bong bu gwa pa sogs// rlung gshog rdzu 'phrul rkang pa myur mgyogs ldan// mig la nyi zla'i 'od zer rab 'phro zhing*// spu las 'dod yon sna lnga'i 'od zer 'phro/ kha rlangs dri bzang na bun phyogs bcur 'phro// gcig las brgya stong khri 'bum grangs med 'phro// glud dang changs bu bdud rtsi'i zhal zas mchog /rang rang yid mthun zad med longs spyod gyur// oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ hūm̐/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun na gnas pa yi// rta drel rngog chags rnams la gnod byed pa'i// bgegs dang log 'dren btsan sri 'byung po'i tshogs// lan chags glud gtor len phyir 'dir 'dus shig /gang dag myur du 'ong bar mi byed rnams// dkon mchog gsum dang khro rgyal rta mgrin gyi// bden pa'i stobs kyis rang dbang med par khug /ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bya/ bde gshegs rin chen mang dang gzugs mdzes dang*// 'byams klas 'jigs kun bral la phyag 'tshal lo// rta glud 'dod yon zad med longs spyod 'di// gnod byed gdon bgegs log 'dren kun la sbyin// rdo rje mchu can sprin gyi sgron me dang*/ khams gsum bdag po byi na ya ka dang*// gdon chen bco brgyad stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs// thams cad mchod sbyin glud 'dis tshims par mdzod// gza' srin klu srin 'gong po dam sri'i tshogs// sa srin yul 'dre gri bo gri mo dang*// mi la bse rag 'byung po the'u rang sogs// glud la dbang ba thams cad glud 'di longs// shi 'dre dur sri dri za dbugs len tshogs// za 'dre gshed 'khyams lam 'dre sgab 'dre dang*// shi 'dre gson 'dre mi kha bra mchu'i tshogs// thams cad glud kyis ngoms shing tshims par mdzod// chu btsan shing btsan la btsan la sogs pa// rta drel rngog chags la gnod btsan sri rnams// rta drel rngog chags stong bas lhag pa yi// rta glud rgyan dang ldan pa 'di bzhes la// bdag cag yon mchod tshe rabs thog med nas// bzhon pa rngog chags brkus phrogs brdungs bsad kyi// lan chags bu lon bdag po thams cad la// rngog chags glud bzang rgya chen 'di 'bul lo// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/

lan gsum mam bdun brjod/ hūm̐/ bgegs dang lan chags btsan sri glud bdag rnams// glud gtor bdud rtsi'i longs spyod 'di phul bas// thams cad ma lus ngoms shing tshims gyur nas// phyin chad gnod cing 'tshe ba ma byed cig /chos rnams thams cad rten 'brel rgyu las byung*// de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i phyir// rang la dpe longs gzhan la gnod 'tshe spongs// sa bon kha mngar 'bras bu mi bslu bzhin// dge sdig gang byas rang la nges par smin// de phyir khyed rnams rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon// glud 'di khyer la phyin chad ma gnod cig /gal te bsngos pa'i glud gtor mi len nam// blangs kyang da rung gnod pa byed gyur na// dkon mchog gsum dang chos nyid rnam dag dang*// rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa bden pa'i stobs// rta mchog he ru ka dang gsang ba'i bdag /gu ru rdo rje gro lod mthu stobs kyis/ khyed kyi lus srog rdul du brlag par 'gyur// tshar mang po gtong na 'di yan wig / de bas glud gtor khyer la gzhan du dengs// phyin chad nam yang gnod par ma byed cig / ces brjod/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs mtshams bcad srung 'khor bsgom par bya'o// zhes rang la mkho ba byung dus rā ga a s+yas 'phral du sbyar ba la nyes pa gang mchis bshags shing sems can la phan par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/// /
